verification_summary.balance_notes: Race washington-county-commissioner-at-large (Chair seat). Fai has 4 bio and 8 positions (5 T1 pamphlet, 3 T3 OPB). Treece has 4 bio and 8 positions (6 T1, 2 T3). Coverage is balanced, with the same outlets for both. Both websites are printed in the pamphlet. Spot-search found OPB 2026-05-19 (primary results/runoff) and KOIN chair-primary coverage that were not used for either candidate. Context: Chair Kathryn Harrington resigned (last day Oct 2, 2026), and neither candidate holds the Chair seat. File-level: name matches pamphlet/official listing. Incumbent false confirmed: county BCC page lists Fai as District 1 Commissioner; the at-large contest is the Chair seat (OPB 2026-09-21: Fai and Treece are running 'to replace Harrington as chair'). Website https://nafisaforwashingtoncounty.com confirmed as printed in the 2026 county pamphlet.
